widgets_values: subtitles, watermark, worst quality, blurry, jittery, distorted, inconsistent appearance

Image 1: Young man, medium skin, slicked-back black hair, strong brows, black leather biker jacket over a plain white T-shirt, dark blue jeans and black leather boots, serious and guarded, photorealistic cinematic style, realistic texture.

Image 2: Young woman, pale skin, short wavy black hair with bangs, wide red headband, pearl stud earrings, red short-sleeved dress with a white Peter Pan collar and white Mary Jane shoes, calm but uneasy, photorealistic cinematic style, realistic texture.

Image 3: Scene, retro roadside diner at night with red leather booths, wooden tables, warm pendant lights, rain-covered windows, blurred cars outside, a glowing neon sign and a vintage cassette player beside the window, warm red-orange interior light contrasting with the cold blue rainy exterior, photorealistic cinematic style, realistic texture.

Audio 1: Male voice, belongs only to Image 1.

Audio 2: Female voice, belongs only to Image 2.

The camera axis remains fixed throughout the sequence. Image 1 is established on the left side of the frame and Image 2 on the right side. Preserve their identities, clothing, screen positions and the cassette player's position across every hard cut.

Medium two-person shot inside the retro roadside diner matching Image 3. Rain runs down the large window behind the red booth. Image 1 sits on the left facing right. Image 2 sits opposite him on the right, with the vintage cassette player resting between them beside the window. Slow dolly push-in about 20%, keeping both characters clearly visible. Image 2 looks directly at Image 1 and speaks with visible lip movement synchronized with Audio 2 while Image 1 watches silently with his lips closed. Audio 2 (Image 2): "You said you'd never come back."

Over-the-shoulder close shot from behind Image 2, framing Image 1's face, slicked-back hair and black leather jacket. Image 2 remains a soft foreground shoulder. Image 1 glances toward the cassette player, then raises his eyes to meet hers. Mostly locked camera with a subtle 10% push-in. Image 1 speaks with visible lip movement synchronized with Audio 1 while Image 2 listens silently with her lips closed. Audio 1 (Image 1): "I didn't. The tape brought me here."

Insert close-up of the vintage cassette player beside the rain-covered window. No characters are visible and no dialogue is heard. The play button presses down by itself with a mechanical click. The two cassette reels begin turning as a small red indicator light flickers. Slow push-in about 15%, with shallow depth of field focused on the moving reels.

Reverse over-the-shoulder close shot from behind Image 1, framing Image 2's face, red headband and pearl earrings while preserving their established screen positions. Red light from the cassette player reflects across her face. Image 2 tightens her fingers around the edge of the table and looks toward the turning cassette. Image 2 speaks with visible lip movement synchronized with Audio 2 while Image 1 listens silently with his lips closed. Audio 2 (Image 2): "That song played the night she disappeared."

Side medium two-person shot with Image 1 on the left and Image 2 on the right. Image 1 reaches toward the cassette player and presses the stop button. The reels stop immediately. He removes the cassette, closes his hand around it and looks at Image 2. Image 1 speaks with visible lip movement synchronized with Audio 1 while Image 2 listens silently with her lips closed. Audio 1 (Image 1): "Then tonight, we find out why." Image 1 stands with the cassette in his hand. Image 2 rises beside him as the diner lights flicker once and the neon glow reflects across the rain-covered window.
